request: Configure the current project to use the supplied Notion integration token in both Claude Code and Codex.
title: Configure token-based Notion MCP
purpose: Enable project-scoped Notion MCP access in Claude Code and Codex without OAuth while keeping the integration token out of Git.

files.purpose: Enable project-scoped Notion MCP access in Claude Code and Codex without OAuth while keeping the integration token out of Git.
files.previous_behavior: Codex targeted the hosted Notion MCP URL, which only worked through OAuth and could not use the supplied integration token.
files.new_behavior: Trusted Codex sessions start the pinned local Notion MCP server through the project wrapper, require successful startup, allow 60 seconds for package startup, and prompt before write-classified Notion tools.
files.data_impact: The configuration itself changes no application or Notion data. It enables later Notion reads and writes within the connected integration's permissions.
files.access_control_impact: Notion access now uses the project-local integration token. Codex prompts for write-classified tools, while the Notion integration's own page grants remain the authoritative access boundary.
risks: The local open-source Notion MCP package is no longer actively maintained.
A valid token can expose every page explicitly shared with the Notion integration, and the server includes mutation tools.
files.rollback: Revert this configuration to the previous hosted URL or remove the mcp_servers.notion table, restart Codex, and remove the project-local token file. No data migration or compatibility work is needed.

files.purpose: Enable project-scoped Notion MCP access in Claude Code and Codex without OAuth while keeping the integration token out of Git.
files.previous_behavior: File did not exist in the baseline commit.
files.new_behavior: The launcher reads and validates NOTION_TOKEN from the ignored project-local environment file, starts the pinned Notion MCP package over stdio, and removes the token from its process environment when the server exits.
files.data_impact: Reads one local secret file. The launcher itself does not modify application or Notion data; invoked MCP tools may read or mutate data within the integration's grants.
files.access_control_impact: Makes the token available only to the child MCP process. It does not expand Notion permissions beyond pages and capabilities already granted to the integration.
risks: The ignored token file is plaintext on the local machine and depends on host filesystem security.
The launcher requires Windows PowerShell, Node.js, npm/npx, and registry availability when the pinned package is not cached.
files.rollback: Remove this script, remove the Claude local MCP registration, restore or delete the Codex Notion configuration, and delete .env.notion-mcp. No application data rollback is needed.

production_safety.operational_data: Verification read only the Notion integration bot identity through API-get-self. No Notion pages, databases, or application records were created, updated, or deleted.
production_safety.schema_migration: None; this change has no database schema, migration, or backfill.
external_side_effects: Registered a Claude Code Local-scope MCP entry for this project in the user's local Claude configuration.
Added this repository path to the user's Codex trusted-project configuration so the project .codex layer can load.
Downloaded or reused @notionhq/notion-mcp-server@2.5.1 through npx and called the Notion API-get-self endpoint for authentication verification.
No deployment, message, or remote repository write occurred.

verification.command: git diff --check; git check-ignore -v .env.notion-mcp; git ls-files --error-unmatch .env.notion-mcp
verification.evidence: The diff has no whitespace errors, .env.notion-mcp matches the repository ignore rule, and the secret file is not tracked.

verification.command: Parse .mcp.json with ConvertFrom-Json and tokenize scripts/notion-mcp.ps1 with System.Management.Automation.PSParser
verification.evidence: The JSON configuration and PowerShell launcher both parsed without errors.

verification.command: Launch scripts/notion-mcp.ps1 over stdio, send MCP initialize and tools/list requests, then call API-get-self
verification.evidence: Initialization succeeded, 24 MCP tools were listed, and the supplied integration token authenticated successfully without exposing returned identity data.
Claude reported Local project scope, stdio transport, and Connected status.

verification.command: codex exec --ephemeral --strict-config --sandbox read-only -c mcp_servers.supabase.enabled=false --json <Notion API-get-self verification prompt>
verification.evidence: A fresh Codex session loaded the project configuration, invoked the Notion API-get-self MCP tool, and returned NOTION_CODEX_OK.

residual_risks: The supplied token was posted in chat and should be rotated; replace the value in .env.notion-mcp after rotation.
The local Notion MCP package is officially no longer actively maintained, so future Notion API changes may require replacing or forking it.
Notion pages and databases remain inaccessible until they are explicitly connected to the integration.
